Smalls Jazz Club.why: Down a staircase, the room puts you close to the musicians and keeps the focus on the music. Late sets are part of the appeal.

Purgatory.why: Check the calendar for local bands, DJ nights, and offbeat bookings in a scruffy Bushwick room with a DIY feel.

Rockwood Music Hall.why: Three rooms keep the shows intimate, with a steady calendar of singer-songwriters, bands, and touring acts. Room 1 is the close-up experience.

Village Vanguard.why: The low-ceilinged basement and triangular room put every table close to the band, while the calendar stays focused on serious jazz.
Village Vanguard.order_this: A weeknight set in the main room

Our Wicked Lady.why: Catch a band downstairs, then head upstairs for DJs and the rooftop. The programming leans punk, indie, and DIY without feeling stuck in one lane.
Our Wicked Lady.order_this: A show followed by the rooftop

C'mon Everybody.why: Live shows, DJ nights, and dance parties share the calendar, giving the room an easygoing alternative to a more polished club night.

Bossa Nova Civic Club.why: Low ceilings, a serious sound system, and a DJ-first calendar make this a reliable late-night stop for techno and electronic music.

Nublu.why: The dark, intimate room favors adventurous programming, moving between global sounds, jazz, funk, and electronic sets.
Nublu.order_this: A live set followed by DJs
